automationNotes: Organization Standard App. Doc §Creating a Project lists nine UI Locations (routes in App.tsx): Stack Dashboard (/stack-dashboard) + Default Width, Asset Sidebar (/asset-sidebar), Custom Field (/custom-field) + Data Type (Text here), Entry Sidebar (/entry-sidebar), App Configuration (/app-configuration), Full Page (/full-page), Field Modifier (/field-modifier) + Allowed Field Types, Content Type Sidebar (/content-type-sidebar), Global Full Page (/global-full-page; org app). Hosting App URL uses ?cs={unique8}. Icon upload omitted. npm/cli out of scope. Optional Install/OAuth.
